# trader-alerts fixtures

Synthetic test data, not real NSE quotes: real US Yahoo chart answers with the
symbol renamed (TSLA -> DEMO.NS, others -> `<TICKER>SYN.NS`), the currency set
to INR and the quote time moved onto the NSE session (9:30 ET -> 9:15 IST).
`yahoo-ZZZZ.json` is Yahoo's own "No data found" answer.
